text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe's freight cargo airline Affretair grounded its DC-8 aircraft this week because it no longer meets required international civil aviation standards.
- British Airways last week flew Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe and part of his delegation to New York from London on its supersonic Concorde jet at ordinary fare as a public relations gesture.
- The public construction and national housing ministry may consider taking legal action to recover funds illegally advanced to beneficiaries of a VIP housing scheme.
- Former Zimbabwean president Canaan Banana will soon be charged with 11 counts of sodomy, attempted sodomy and indecent assault, Attorney-General Patrick Chinamasa said on Thursday.
- Several files containing details of people under investigation for abusing the War Veterans' Compensation Fund were destroyed by demonstrators on Thursday.
